review_candidates.description: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. You will collaborate with IT teams to implement and integrate AWS infrastructure solutions based on existing designs. Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include Set up and Configure AWS Resources: Set up, configure, and manage AWS EC2 instances, storage solutions, networking, and databases to effectively support business applications. This includes implementing and overseeing essential AWS resources such as Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), Elastic Load Balancers (ELBs), and Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Monitor and Troubleshoot AWS Infrastructure: Continuously monitor AWS infrastructure, troubleshoot issues, and maintain high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) configurations to ensure reliable performance. Optimize AWS Costs: Optimize AWS costs by right-sizing resources, developing cost-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns. Automate Processes: Use automation tools like AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and Ansible to automate and streamline processes. Cloud Migration Expertise: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, and proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters through Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). Security Compliance Knowledge: Familiarity with applying and enforcing security measures to ensure AWS infrastructure complies with organizational policies and industry regulations. Cost Optimization Skills: Experience with optimizing AWS costs by right-sizing resources, developing cost-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns. Preferred Technical And Professional Experience Cloud Migration Project Management: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, with proficiency in managing Kubernetes clusters through Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS). Advanced Automation Skills: Proficiency in using automation tools like AWS CloudFormation, Terraform, and Ansible to automate and streamline processes. Linux and VMware Expertise: Expertise in Linux and VMware environments, with the ability to apply this knowledge to AWS-based infrastructure solutions.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter. Benefits Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes: Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours. This role has a 50/50 hybrid working arrangement. Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing. Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities. Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities. Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way. And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive. About The Team You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes. The Opportunity This role is an opportunity to contribute to the Matrix Engineering Group by designing, building, supporting and accrediting large enterprise infrastructure platforms for mission-critical Federal Government environments. You will work with the Program Engineering Lead, engineering teams and customer stakeholders to understand requirements, solve complex technical problems and support reliable platform delivery. The team works 50:50 from site and home. In This Role, You Will Translate customer requirements into detailed designs and supporting services for complex Platform as a Service solutions. Install, configure, upgrade and maintain Microsoft Windows Server and Red Hat Enterprise Linux platform services delivered through VMware environments. Tune system performance and use automation and infrastructure-as-code practices to streamline builds, configuration deployment, health checks and repeatable operational processes. Produce and maintain technical, system and operational documentation, provide specialist advice and resolve complex infrastructure issues, including hands-on support at customer sites when required. The technical environment includes Cisco UCS, VMware Cloud Foundation, Microsoft Windows Server, Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, DFS, enterprise backup products, storage technologies and infrastructure-as-code practices. About You We are looking for someone who brings judgement, curiosity and a collaborative approach to work that matters. Essential For This Role Extensive experience with Cisco UCS and VMware Cloud Foundation solutions, including integration with network and supporting services. Experience in server administration across Microsoft Windows Server 2012, 2016, 2019 and 2022. Capability in administering Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and DFS, together with knowledge of enterprise backup products. Ability to diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure issues, tune system performance and produce clear technical and operational documentation. Ability to communicate technical advice and work effectively with engineering teams, customers and other stakeholders. Advantageous, But Not Essential Experience with storage technologies and administration, particularly NetApp. Experience applying infrastructure-as-code and automation practices to enterprise platform delivery and operations. Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) or MCTIP certification. VMware Certified Professional (VCP) certification. ITIL Foundation certification. This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian citizen and hold an NV1 security clearance. Certain roles may be subject International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) requirements which may limit persons who hold dual nationality with certain proscribed countries from accessing material, or in the case of dual Australian-U.S citizens, may require the candidate to obtain a U.S. Persons Abroad authorisation from the U.S DDTC. If this role interests you, we encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and are interested in the capability and potential you could bring. What To Expect When You Apply Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect: An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel Any role-specific assessment, technical discussion or customer step required for the position We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know. Ready to explore what’s possible? If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact Kat Buckingham, Talent Acquisition. If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares. Original Posting For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above. Pay Range The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. About Leidos Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com. Pay And Benefits Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits. Securing Your Data Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission. Validar componentes das plataformas e realizar abertura, acompanhamento e escalonamento de incidentes. Acompanhar e participar do planejamento de projetos em produção. Implementar mudanças e novas versões de sistemas. Atuar na monitoração, operação e automação do ambiente de produção. Experiência superior a 3 anos na área de TI e experiência com suporte a ambientes de produção. Experiência avançada em automação de processos utilizando Bash, Python ou PowerShell. Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais MS Windows Server, SunOS e Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL). Conhecimento em plataformas Web e servidores de aplicação, incluindo Apache, Tomcat, IIS, JBoss e WebLogic. Experiência em soluções Cloud, incluindo Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) e AWS. Senso crítico, boa comunicação, resiliência, flexibilidade e adaptabilidade. Conhecimento em tecnologias de containers, como Docker, Kubernetes e OpenShift. Conhecimento em soluções de IaC – Infraestrutura como Código (Ansible, Terraform, Puppet ou Python). review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Must Have Technical/Functional Skills Expert in implementing, and support Cisco ACI (policy model, contracts, EPGs, fabric troubleshooting). Administer and troubleshoot Palo Alto Firewalls including: Security policies, NAT, routing VPN (IPSec, site-to-site, remote access) Panorama management and threat prevention profiles Manage and support enterprise wireless networks (Cisco, Aruba, or equivalent), including RF optimization, roaming, and high-density deployments. Design, configure, and troubleshoot IPSec VPNs, including third-party interoperability. Administer Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM) including grid management, failover, and automation integration. Lead hands-on P1 troubleshooting for complex network issues across Application, LAN, WAN, DC, and security domains. Real-time packet capture skills to investigate complex issues during live P1 calls. (Wireshark) Required Technical Skills Cisco ACI: APIC, EPGs, contracts, fabric health, L2/L3 connectivity Palo Alto Firewalls: PAN-OS, Panorama, security policies, IPSec VPN, NAT Wireless: Enterprise WLAN design, RF analysis, troubleshooting VPN: IPSec site-to-site, remote access, multi-vendor environments Infoblox: DNS, DHCP, IPAM, Grid Master, HA Networking Fundamentals: TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, QoS, multicast Roles & Responsibilities Troubleshooting the Level 3 and advanced network issues and performing call backs ensuring issues are resolved & appropriate solution is provided to the customer in a high pressure factory environments Responsible for investigating causes, tests solutions & suggest solutions in place to reduce the time taken to resolve the network related tickets. Manage new and existing equipment, hardware, and network device software upgrades. Understanding Network support priorities and objectives and taking an active role in accomplishing them. Should be able to lead and drive technically the Operational issues on his own in a high pressure environment engaging multiple stakeholders during live troubleshooting. Help level 1 & level 2 resources to address the Network related issues. Strong understanding of network routing and switching protocols required. Excellent analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical issues in an easy-to-understand manner. Resourceful, with the ability to work independently. Strong time management skills and attention to detail. Ability to multi-task activities with shifting priorities. Generic Managerial Skills, If Any Should be able to lead and drive the Operational issues on his own. Location: Reno, Nevada Salary Range: $95,000 - $135,000 a year
